stories.title: Build Allowlist Enforcement Engine
stories.description: Implement core backend logic that evaluates sanitized queries against the allowlist schema, enforcing permitted collections, fields, operators, and limits before execution.

stories.title: Integrate Enforcement into Azure Function Entry Point
stories.description: Modify Azure Function (GPTReader endpoint) to require all incoming requests to pass through the enforcement engine prior to any MongoDB query execution.

stories.title: Standardize Rejection Responses for Violations
stories.description: Implement consistent error handling for rejected queries, including safe error messages, HTTP status codes, and prevention of internal schema or database leakage.

stories.title: Add Audit Logging for Enforcement Decisions
stories.description: Extend existing audit logging to capture allowlist enforcement outcomes (allowed, rejected, reason) for each request without storing sensitive query payloads.
